exposure: Vitex agnus-castus L. (VAC) extract (365 mg/kg) initiated from insemination
Vitex agnus-castus L. (VAC) extract (365 mg/kg) initiated 30 days prior to pregnancy
cohort: The study included 48 rats divided into six groups, some treated with Vitex agnus-castus L. extract at different timings relative to conception, and some undergoing caesarean section on day 15 of gestational age.
finding: Vitex agnus-castus L. extract was found to affect pregnancy rate, live birth rate, abortion, and stillbirth rates, with its effect on fetus weight and sex showing a dual pattern dependent on administration timing.
birth_weight: Weight of fetuses was measured (increased in T1, decreased in T2, slightly increased in T3, decreased in T4).
gest_age: Evaluations performed at day 15 of gestational age for some groups.
